newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine MPC arm to sign $55 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Philippine MPC arm to sign $55 mln loan.

text.p: Cellular phone operator Smart Communications Inc said on Saturday it will sign next week a two-year $55-million loan agreement with a group of local and foreign banks to finance its expansion.

"Smart and a syndicate of banks led by ING Bank N.V. will sign Monday a short-term loan agreement for the Japanese yen equivalent of $55 million to finance Smart's cellular mobile telephone system expansion programme," the firm said in a statement.
Aside from ING, other lenders are Banque Nationale de Paris, Credit Lyonnais, Philippine National Bank, Deutsche Bank A.G., and Societe Generale Hong Kong.
Smart is affiliated with Metro Pacific Corp (MPC), Nippon Telegraph and Telephone, and First Pacific Co Ltd.
The firm said its subscribers base had reached 240,000 by the end of September.
